component.primary_fraction_note: Historical source has no primary_fraction sampler parameter.
deviations: Fixed caller official folds with external auxiliary rows in every fit, rather than author CV over each union.
Task weights recomputed on the supplied training partition, rather than full-source counts.
Public CSVs are current pinned snapshots; historical trained model/OOF artifacts are unavailable.
External structures use normalized neutral nonstereo parents and exclude all provided official train/test parents.

wide_table.aggregation: median within normalized isomeric identity and specified head; equality-only

assembly.join_identity: FragmentParent + uncharge + canonical isomeric SMILES; no tautomer canonicalization
assembly.row_order: Original official training order followed by deterministic public-only rows
assembly.primary_label_policy: Official labels preserved; appended public rows have unknown primary labels
assembly.heldout_policy: Exclusion applies only to public rows; caller supplies all official train+test parents for campaign policy
assembly.roundtrip_filter: External normalized SMILES must parse after uncharging; base rows are never silently removed.

bindingdb_native_articles.license_note: BindingDB Info links native data CC-BY; ChEMBL imports retain CC-BY-SA. Native-only rows selected.

loader.normalization: FragmentParent, uncharge, remove stereo; no tautomer canonicalization
loader.unknown_labels: Retained as missing/unknown; never converted to inactive or numerical potency
